compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem

Once the legacy `reconcile` CLI route and its `--filter-local-ids` flag are removed (by seagreen-wet-bluefish / 82bb-439b-1c42-4abd), the legacy route is the ONLY producer of a non-None `ctx.filter_local_ids`. `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/request.py:95` documents it: "--filter-local-ids is available only on the legacy route." After that removal the internal `filter_local_ids` field defaults to `None` everywhere, so every `selection_ids or filter_local_ids` fallback collapses to `selection_ids` and every `if filter_local_ids:` branch is dead.

This ticket removes that now-dead engine plumbing (a pure simplification, no behavior change), kept SEPARATE from 82bb to keep the CLI-removal change bounded and reviewable.

## Scope

Remove the always-None `filter_local_ids` parameter/field and its dead branches from the reconciler engine, threading through only where it was a real input:
- `_engine/rebar_reconciler/reconcile.py` (field + param)
- `_engine/rebar_reconciler/apply_phase.py` (post-filter branch + `_build_filter_target_set` call)
- `_engine/rebar_reconciler/load_phase.py`, `outbound_pass.py`, `run_differs.py`, `snapshot_lagfree_refresh.py` (`selection_ids or filter_local_ids` fallbacks collapse to `selection_ids`)
- `_engine/rebar_reconciler/persist_phase.py` (result["filter_local_ids"] emission)
- `_engine/rebar_reconciler/pass_support.py` (`_build_filter_target_set` helper, if unused elsewhere)
- `_engine/rebar_reconciler/__main__.py` / `request.py` (residual internal field, after 82bb removes the flag)

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `filter_local_ids` is fully removed from the reconciler engine; no `selection_ids or filter_local_ids` fallbacks or `if filter_local_ids:` branches remain.
- [ ] The canonical `--only`/`--except` selection (`selection_ids`) path is unchanged and proven by existing scoped-pass tests.
- [ ] No change to any persisted state, exit code, or reconcile result contract.

## Depends on

Must land AFTER 82bb (seagreen-wet-bluefish) removes the legacy reconcile CLI route + `--filter-local-ids` flag.
